v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ámplius lava me, * Dómine, ab iniustítia mea.
text.en: O Lord, wash me * yet more from my iniquity.
O Lord, * thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

text.la: In innocéntia * cordis mei perambulábo, Dómine.
text.en: I walked in the innocence * of my heart, O Lord.

text.la: Exsultávit cor meum * in Dómino, qui humíliat et súblevat.
text.en: My heart hath rejoiced * in the Lord, he humbleth and he exalteth.

text.la: Lauda * ánima mea Dóminum, qui érigit elísos et díligit iustos.
text.en: Praise * the Lord my soul, he lifts up those who fall, and loves the just.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Rabbi, quid peccávit * homo iste, quod cæcus natus est? Respóndit Iesus, et dixit: Neque hic peccávit, neque paréntes eius: sed ut manifesténtur ópera Dei in illo.
text.en: Rabbi, who did sin, this man, or his parents, * that he was born blind? Jesus answered, and said: Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents; but that the works of God shall be made manifest in him.

text.la: Deus, qui et iustis prǽmia meritórum, et peccatóribus per ieiúnium véniam præbes: miserére supplícibus tuis; ut reátus nostri conféssio indulgéntiam váleat percípere delictórum.
text.en: O God, Who by mean of fasting dost give unto the righteous the reward of their good works, and unto sinners pardon; have mercy upon us, we beseech thee, and grant that we, humbly confessing our guiltiness, may so be enabled to obtain thy forgiveness.
